role: held-out: annotated after all parameters were fixed on the 30-90 s segment; nothing was tuned on it
method: Crop timelines: every local track in the window, 10 crops sampled along it with shared-time stamps and image position (gt_tool tracks), plus frame sheets every 6 s. Tracks are assigned to people by clothing, position and timing. No system identities were shown during review.
reviewer_note: Single reviewer (developer). Clothing in this window is distinctive, so cross-camera pairs are mostly unambiguous; uncertain tracks are marked probable or left unannotated (ignored by the metrics).
